I'm sorry, having to write three times about a dead plant is frustrating. Under our policy, a dead live plant isn't eligible for a cash refund. The Plant Care Guarantee covers one free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock). To claim it, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up) within your guarantee window, which is 30 days from delivery or 90 days for Leafy Plus plants ordered while your membership was active. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.

My excerpts don't cover cancelling Leafy Plus or how cancelling affects your 90-day guarantee, so I won't guess. I can escalate that, and your repeated contacts, to a Support Lead. Would you like me to do that? Please submit the guarantee claim first so it stays within the window.
